evidence: News flow heading into November 28, 2018, reflects persistent bearish pressure following weeks of aggressive market sell-offs. Direct market reporting highlights Bitcoin consolidating choppily around the $3,700 level, with analysts warning of risks toward $2,970 amid ongoing technical weakness. Security headlines detailing malicious code in Copay wallet dependencies also added caution to short-term sentiment. While institutional signals such as Nasdaq maintaining plans for 2019 futures and Tether reopening its redemption platform provided minor stabilization, short-term sentiment remains slanted toward further downside or choppy stagnation.
